summary: Focus monitoring web application with productive/distractive app categorization, tab switch tracking, warning system, and session-based locking
architectural_notes: Web-based focus monitoring system (cannot block external browser tabs or desktop apps)
Track navigation within app between productive/distractive content sections
Grayscale CSS filter applied only to distractive content sections during warning period
Session-based restriction system tied to user-defined timer duration

existing_features.title: Create a focus session setup interface where users can select a session duration (time-based) before starting their focus work, with options for common durations like 25, 45, 60, 90 minutes or custom duration input

Implement tab switch tracking specifically between productive and distractive content sections within the app, incrementing a violation counter each time user navigates from productive to distractive sections
Implement a three-strike warning system that applies a grayscale visual effect to distractive content sections for exactly 2 minutes after the third violation (switch to distractive content)
After the 2-minute grayscale warning period ends, reset the violation counter to zero and start a new warning cycle, allowing the user to continue with a fresh count
Lock and restrict all access to distractive content sections until the user's focus session timer completes, preventing navigation to distractive sections even if user attempts to access them
When focus session timer completes, automatically lift all restrictions and allow full access to both productive and distractive sections, with option for user to start a new focus session if needed

new_feature_requests.summary: Productive and distractive app/content selection interface
Tab switch tracking between productive and distractive sections
Three-strike warning system with grayscale effect on distractive sections for 2 minutes
Warning cycle reset after 2-minute grayscale period
Focus session timer with user-defined duration
Lock/restrict distractive sections until session timer completes
Session reset capability when timer ends or user needs more time
Store focus session data (duration, violations, completion status) in the backend for each completed session to enable historical tracking and analytics
